_comment: ViBE-aligned config: TP=8 (dense) + EP=8 (MoE) on 8 GPUs in ONE node, single instance (no dp_group). TP ALLREDUCE on non-MoE layers + EP AllGather/ReduceScatter on MoE -- all 8 GPUs in lockstep, exactly ViBE Table 2a. This uses the independent-instance path (NOT the multi-instance dp_group path that deadlocks at TP>1), so it runs cleanly once tp8 perf data exists (profiler/perf/H100/.../tp8/). Set link_bw/link_latency to the 8-GPU fabric under test (e.g. glass panel 512/100 or H100 NVLink4 450/500).
